# opnsense_dyndns_account (Data Source)

Dynamic DNS accounts (**Services ▸ Dynamic DNS**, plugin `os-ddclient`): the provider, credentials and host names updated with the firewall's address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the dynamic DNS account.

### Read-Only

- `checkip` (String) How the firewall's current address is found: `if` / `if6` (address of `interface`), or a web service such as `cloudflare-ipv4` or `web_ipify-ipv4`. The values depend on the backend chosen in `opnsense_dyndns_settings`.
- `checkip_timeout` (Number) How long to wait before the checkip process times out.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `dynipv6host` (String) Swap the interface identifier of the ipv6 address with the given partial ipv6 address (the least significant 64 bits of the address).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this virtual server.
- `force_ssl` (Boolean) Force update using HTTPS, please note setting this option will enforce https updates on all accounts as ddclient only supports SSL=yes on a global level (the check ip service may still use HTTP on other services).
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Hostname to update.
- `interface` (String) Interface to monitor.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password associated with this account. Never returned by OPNsense, always null.
- `protocol` (String) Select the protocol to use. One of `dyndns1`, `dyndns2`, `get`, `post`, `put`.
- `resource_id` (String) resourceId.
- `server` (String) DynDNS Server hostname or uri to use (depending on the protocol). When a URI is provided, the tag __MYIP__ will be replaced with the current detected address for this service and __HOSTNAME__ will contain the (comma separated) list of hostnames provided.
- `service` (String) Select the service to use. One of `hosting1984`, `changeip`, `cloudflare`, `cloudns`, `digitalocean`, `dinahosting`, `dnsmadeeasy`, `dns-o-matic`, `dnsexit2`, `dyndns2`, `dnspark`, `dnspodcn`, `dslreports1`, `dondominio`, `duckdns`, `dynu`, `easydns`, `freedns`, `freemyip`, `gandi`, `godaddy`, `googledomains`, `he-net`, `he-net-tunnel`, `hetzner`, `inwx`, `keysystems`, `loopia`, `mythicdyn`, `namecheap`, `nfsn`, `njalla`, `noip`, `nsupdatev4`, `nsupdatev6`, `ovh`, `porkbun`, `regfishde`, `servercow`, `sitelutions`, `spdyn`, `strato`, `woima`, `yandex`, `zoneedit1`, `custom`.
- `ttl` (Number) Time to Live for the DNS entry.
- `username` (String) Username or login to use.
- `wildcard` (Boolean) add a DNS wildcard CNAME record that points to the configured host.
- `zone` (String) Zone containing the host entry.
